text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I couldn't run `python3 -m unittest` because I don't have a shell here. I checked each fix by reading it against its test, and I didn't change any tests. Please run the suite to confirm everything passes.

- **`fees.py`**: the late fee added the daily rate to the number of days instead of multiplying them (`days_late * DAILY_FEE`).
- **`members.py`**: the borrowing limit was 3; the comment and tests say 5, so I set `MAX_BORROWED = 5`.
- **`inventory.py`**: `recent(n)` returned one event too many. It now returns the last `n` events, and an empty list when `n <= 0`.
- **`factory.py`**: added the missing `Emma` (Austen, 1815) to the sample books, so there are now three.
- **`books.py`**: `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`, which also makes `age()` work.
- **`search.py`**: it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist (`catalog.nonexistent`); it now imports it from `catalog.text`.
